TOP SEAFOOD RESTAURANT IN VUNG TAU
Jan 2024 • Friends
We stayed one night in Vong Tau near the sea and just had to eat at one of the restaurants serving seafood.
There were plenty of seafood restaurants along the road. This restaurant was recommended as one of the top three in Vong Tau.
Our group of six ordered live grouper, pork ribs, spring rolls, bitter gourd with eggs,octopus and fried rice with crabs.
The fish was steamed ,hong kong style. It was as fresh as you can expect from live fish. Unlikely to be from the sea so must be a farmed fish. The fish had a new twist in the serving. The fish was wrapped with vegetables and a special noodle, similar to the way pekingese duck is served. This is the first time l have eaten fish this way. The group preferred the traditional way of enjoying steamed fish. The octopus was tasty. One of us was hoping to find roe in the octopus. Very unlikely as octopus with roe is a special find. The pork ribs were very well done.
The fried rice with crab meat was good but the crab meat need close scrutiny to find.
Someone asked me to give a rating. I gave this meal a 7.5/10.
Have to say we enjoyed the value for money seafood meal.

Vietnamese Seafood Delight
Oct 2023 • Couples
Had a beautiful seaside dinner for two here with a Vietnamese friend. We sat right next to the ocean on a lovely autumn evening. Service was lovely, my friend had been here a couple of times before over the past ten years and ordered for both of us in Vietnamese after checking with me if I had any particular likes/dislikes.

The service was spot on and the food came in a consistent way, no time delays. The seafood was ultra fresh and all dishes prepared in a very Vietnamese style. Personal favourites included scallops & squid & a delicious variety of sea snails.

Dinner for two plus a couple of local beers was under 2 million with tip. We were both surprised it was not more. Anywhere else in the world at such a seaside location would have been a lot more. Well worth a visit.
